verdict.line: You lose if you eat her full Runic Blade combo standing still, and you win if you save Counter Strike for her all-in and out-duel her once her cooldowns are down.

brief.thesis: Riven's damage comes from Runic Blade charges consumed by empowered autos, not from her abilities' raw numbers — so her entire combo is really three basic attacks wearing a Q/W wrapper. Jax's E (Counter Strike) dodges all incoming basic attacks, which means it can no-sell the exact hits that make her combo dangerous if timed on her auto chain instead of on her dash.

theirWindow.when: she has 3 blade charges and Q, W both up
theirWindow.what: This is her full all-in: Q in, W (Ki Burst) stuns, then three empowered autos consuming Runic Blade charges do the real damage. Hold E (Counter Strike) and pop it right as she starts auto-attacking — you dodge the empowered autos entirely, and the stun that follows locks her out of chasing with her remaining Q charges.

yourWindow.when: her Q (Broken Wings) and E (Valor) are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Riven has no dash to reposition and no Valor to block damage. Walk in with W (Empower) on your next auto or Leap Strike — she can't disengage and can't reduce the hit.

powerCurve.note: Neither side has a real combo online yet
Full Q-W-empowered auto all-in before your E ranks up
R (Relentless Assault) and her ult both online
W near-maxed, empowered trades outpace her cooldowns
Trinity Force spike beats her cooldown-reliant burst

start.why: The AD and sustain let you eat a poke or two from Broken Wings without being pressured into all-in range early, where her Runic Blade combo hits hardest.

boots.why: Her damage is almost entirely auto-attack based once Runic Blade is charged, so flat physical reduction directly undercuts her combo.

core.why: The Empower-into-Sheen proc rewards exactly the trade pattern you want: land W, then auto or Leap Strike for the bonus hit.
Stacks with your own Counter Strike stun window and gives healing on crit to outlast her short trade windows.
Survives her all-in if she catches you with Q charges and Ignite up, buying time for your own cooldowns to reset.

situational.when: she's ahead and pressuring you into extended all-ins you can't fully dodge
she builds tanky or the game goes long and you need sustained dueling damage
the enemy team stacks CC or magic damage beyond Riven herself

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed rewards standing and trading autos once you've dodged her burst with E, and it stacks with R's own attack speed gain for sustained damage her cooldown-limited kit can't match.

summoners.why: This is a near-50/50 head-to-head (50.2% over 611 games), so the highest-win-rate spell pair (52.6%) that adds kill pressure is the right call — Ignite closes out the even trades that Counter Strike sets up.

playing.title: Hold E for her auto chain, not her Q
playing.detail: Counter Strike dodges basic attacks, not Broken Wings itself. Wait until she's actually swinging on you before you pop it.

playing.title: Count her Runic Blade charges
playing.detail: Her passive shows stacked charges on her attack icon. Don't stand in extended autos once she's at 3 — that's when her damage spikes.

playing.title: Trade when Q and E are down
playing.detail: Without Broken Wings or Valor she can't gap-close or block damage. Walk in with an Empowered auto or Leap Strike.

playing.title: Punish her wave-clear Q
playing.detail: If she burns Broken Wings charges to clear minions, her 13s cooldown is down — use Leap Strike to engage immediately.

playing.title: Play for your level 9-11 spike
playing.detail: W ranks up fastest in this build (maxed by level 9), so shift from cautious trading to forcing fights once you hit that window.

playing.title: Time Zhonya's around her all-in
playing.detail: If she catches your E on cooldown with Ignite up, Zhonya's buys the time you need for Counter Strike to reset.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the timing and combo breakdown are my own read of the ability interactions.

stats.opponentTip: Block Riven’s basic attacks, third Broken Wings (Q), or Ki Burst (W) with Counter Strike [E].
